rules.title: Source-of-income discrimination ban (Gov. Code § 12955(a), (p))
rules.requirement: Owners of housing accommodations may not discriminate against or harass any person because of source of income, which includes lawful, verifiable income paid to a tenant or on a tenant's behalf, such as public assistance and housing subsidies including Section 8 and HUD-VASH vouchers. Inquiring about the level or source of income is not itself discrimination.

coverage_conditions.summary: All owners of housing accommodations in California; no unit-count or construction-date limits stated in this section.

rules.quoted_span: For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.

rules.title: Aggregate income standard for co-residents (Gov. Code § 12955(n))
rules.requirement: A financial or income standard used in renting housing must account for the aggregate income of persons residing or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income of married persons.

coverage_conditions.summary: Any rental of housing using a financial or income standard.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Applies where applicants reside or propose to reside together.

rules.quoted_span: To use a financial or income standard in the rental of housing that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing together or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income

rules.title: Income standard based on tenant's share of subsidized rent (Gov. Code § 12955(o)(1)(A))
rules.requirement: Where a government rent subsidy applies, a landlord may not use a financial or income standard to assess rental eligibility that is not based on the portion of the rent the tenant will pay.
rules.key_value: Income standard must be based on tenant's portion of rent

coverage_conditions.summary: Rentals involving a government rent subsidy.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Only where there is a government rent subsidy.

rules.exemptions: Does not limit an owner's ability to request information or documentation to verify employment, request landlord references, or verify identity (§ 12955(o)(2)).
rules.quoted_span: Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.

rules.title: Alternative evidence in lieu of credit history for subsidized rentals (Gov. Code § 12955(o)(1)(B))
rules.requirement: Where a government rent subsidy applies, a landlord using credit history in the application process must offer the applicant the option of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of ability to pay their portion of the rent. If the applicant elects this, the landlord must allow reasonable time to respond and reasonably consider that evidence in lieu of credit history.

coverage_conditions.summary: Rental applications involving a government rent subsidy where credit history is used.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Only where there is a government rent subsidy.

rules.exemptions: Does not limit an owner's ability to request information or documentation to verify employment, request landlord references, or verify identity (§ 12955(o)(2)).
rules.quoted_span: Use a person’s credit history as part of the application process for a rental accommodation without offering the applicant the option, at the applicant’s discretion, of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of the applicant’s reasonable ability to pay
